blocks.text: Aaj 2 crore se zyada carbon compounds maloom hain, aur zyada tar organic chemistry mein parhe jate hain, jise IUPAC aise compounds ka mutala kehta hai jin mein carbon khud se, hydrogen se ya doosre anasir se jura ho, kuch inorganic compounds ke siwa. Carbonates, cyanides (maslan KCN), carbon dioxide aur carbon monoxide riwayati taur par inorganic maane jate hain. Organic compounds ke pighalne aur ubalne ke darje, kasafat aur paani mein hall pazeeri aam taur par kam hoti hai.

blocks.title: Catenation
blocks.text: Catenation aik hi unsar ke atoms ki aapas mein jurne ki salahiyat hai (Latin catena, yani zanjeer, se). Carbon mustahkam C-C covalent bonds ke zariye lambi zanjeerein aur halqe (rings) banata hai.

Kyunke carbon tetravalent (chaar bonds banane wala) hai, is ke atoms bohat mukhtalif tareeqon se tarteeb pa sakte hain. Sirf chaar carbon atoms bhi chaar mukhtalif tarteebon mein jur sakte hain. Catenation batata hai ke organic compounds bare aur pecheeda kyun ho sakte hain aur itne zyada kyun hain.

blocks.alt: Chaar carbon atoms ki chaar tarteebein, har C seedhi lakeeron se jura: seedhi zanjeer C-C-C-C; teen C ki zanjeer jis ke beech wale C ke neeche chautha C; square ke chaar konon par chaar C; aur teen C ka triangle jis ke oopar wale C par chautha C.
blocks.caption: Chaar carbon atoms ki chaar mukhtalif tarteebein (kitab ki be-number figure ke mutabiq asal khaaka).

blocks.title: Diagram ko samjhein
blocks.text: Chaaron mein sirf carbon ka dhaancha (skeleton) dikhaya gaya hai; har C ke baqi bond H atoms se poore hote hain. Pehli seedhi zanjeer (straight chain) hai: butane. Doosri shaakh wali zanjeer (branched chain) hai: 2-methylpropane. Teesri chaar carbon ka halqa (ring) hai: cyclobutane. Chauthi teen carbon ka halqa aur aik shaakh hai: methylcyclopropane. Yahi catenation hai: carbon khud se jur kar zanjeerein aur halqe banata hai.

blocks.prompt: Paanch carbon atoms wale mumkin dhaanchon ke naam batayein.
blocks.explanation: Khuli zanjeerein: pentane, 2-methylbutane aur 2,2-dimethylpropane. Halqe: cyclopentane, methylcyclobutane, ethylcyclopropane, 1,1-dimethylcyclopropane aur 1,2-dimethylcyclopropane.

blocks.prompt: Chhe carbon atoms wale mukhtalif khuli zanjeer ke dhaanche batayein.

items: Catenation: aik unsar ke atoms ka zanjeeron aur halqon mein jurna.
Tetravalent carbon bohat tarteebein deta: chaar C atoms se hi chaar dhaanche.
